Our Story

Meet Popy

8+ Years
Expert

Crafting Beauty with Precision

Hi, I'm Popy! With over 8 years of experience in beauty services, I've dedicated my career to the art of precision eyebrow threading and intricate henna design.

I am passionate about helping women feel confident and beautiful in their own skin. My techniques are gentle, hygienic, and always tailored to each client's unique features and personal style.

Located at my private studio in Moreno Valley, California, every visit is a relaxing, personalized experience designed around you.
